evidencePolicy: fact, reasoned-inference, and unknown are deliberately separated.

service.name: DealCatch
service.description: DealCatch is a Korean-language, free, local-device-first hot-deal discovery and community web service. It lets a shopper browse four deal boards, search and filter listings, inspect a generated 30-day price history, save/share search conditions, follow keywords, and participate through votes, comments, reports, and sold-out reports.
evidence: README.md: project description and verified features

users.reason: Korean UI, deal boards, seller/price/date filters, price history, and keyword notices.
Posting, voting, comments, reports, and sold-out reports are documented in README.

problem.value: Finding credible time-sensitive deals and retaining useful search conditions without requiring a server account.

coreFlow: Open mobile or PC web surface
Browse four boards or use search, sort, seller, price, and date filters
Open a deal and inspect price-history and discussion signals
Save or share a sanitized search condition; optionally bookmark and receive local keyword notices
Export/import local backup when the user chooses
